basic_details.job_title: District Panchayat Koriya Gram Panchayat Sachiv Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 10 Posts

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The minimum age of the applicant must not be less than 18 years, and the maximum age must not exceed 35 years as per the notification date. Local residents of Chhattisgarh are eligible for a 5-year upper age relaxation up to 40 years. Upper age limit inclusive of all relaxations shall not exceed 45 years for special categories (SC, ST, OBC, Women, Persons with Disabilities), and up to 45 years for government employees, Nigam/Mandal workers, contractual personnel, and ex-servicemen as per general administration department norms.

qualification.details: Applicant must be a native resident (sthai mool niwasi) of Koriya district. | Applicants must also have an active employment exchange registration in Koriya district as of the date of application.

selection_process: Higher Educational Qualification 10 marks (Graduate - 05 marks / Post-Graduate - 05 marks)
Experience as Rojgar Sahayak 15 marks (03 marks per year up to maximum 05 years, minimum 09 months required)
The selection process comprises merit list preparation based on educational marks
10 candidates per post will be called based on merit. The test will include 15 minutes of English typing and 15 minutes of Hindi typing.
how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form and notification PDF from the official website www.korea.gov.in or the notice board.
Fill out the application form carefully in Hindi or English in capital letters as specified in the format.
Affix a self-attested recent passport-size photograph on the designated space of the application form.
Enclose self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, mark sheets, local residence certificate, employment exchange card, category certificate, and experience certificates.
Attach a self-addressed envelope affixed with postage stamps worth Rs. 55/-.
Send the completed application in an envelope clearly superscribed with "Pad ka naam - Gram Panchayat Sachiv hetu avedan patr" via registered post or speed post.
Mail or submit the application to the Office of Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat Koriya, Baikunthpur (Chhattisgarh) on or before 22 October 2026 up to 05:00 PM.
important_instructions: Applications received after the last date and time (22 October 2026, 05:00 PM) or submitted directly by hand/ordinary post will not be accepted. Incomplete application forms or lack of required self-attested documents will lead to automatic rejection. No application fee or correction window is provided after submission. Selected candidates will be appointed on a probation period of 3 years, which may be extended by 2 years. Providing false information will result in cancellation of candidature and legal action. Active employment registration in Koriya district employment exchange is mandatory.

content_sections.heading: District Panchayat Koriya Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicant must be a native resident (sthai mool niwasi) of Koriya district. Applicants must also have an active employment exchange registration in Koriya district as of the date of application.

rows.qualification_required: (i) Higher Secondary Board Examination passed.(ii) One-year diploma in Data Entry Operator / Programming from a recognized institution approved by the Government.

content_sections.heading: District Panchayat Koriya Age Limit
content_sections.text: The minimum age of the applicant must not be less than 18 years, and the maximum age must not exceed 35 years as per the notification date. Local residents of Chhattisgarh are eligible for a 5-year upper age relaxation up to 40 years. Upper age limit inclusive of all relaxations shall not exceed 45 years for special categories (SC, ST, OBC, Women, Persons with Disabilities), and up to 45 years for government employees, Nigam/Mandal workers, contractual personnel, and ex-servicemen as per general administration department norms.

rows.post: The selected Gram Panchayat Sachiv will receive dearness allowance and other allowances as per rules.

content_sections.heading: District Panchayat Koriya Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: District Panchayat Koriya Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises merit list preparation based on educational marks, experience, and a computer skill test. For the computer skill test, 10 candidates per post will be called based on merit. The test will include 15 minutes of English typing and 15 minutes of Hindi typing.

rows.weightage_marks: 15 marks (03 marks per year up to maximum 05 years, minimum 09 months required)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Panchayat Koriya Recruitment
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form and notification PDF from the official website www.korea.gov.in or the notice board. Fill out the application form carefully in Hindi or English in capital letters as specified in the format. Affix a self-attested recent passport-size photograph on the designated space of the application form. Enclose self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, mark sheets, local residence certificate, employment exchange card, category certificate, and experience certificates. Attach a self-addressed envelope affixed with postage stamps worth Rs. 55/-. Send the completed application in an envelope clearly superscribed with "Pad ka naam - Gram Panchayat Sachiv hetu avedan patr" via registered post or speed post. Mail or submit the application to the Office of Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat Koriya, Baikunthpur (Chhattisgarh) on or before 22 October 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of 10th marksheet and certificate Self-attested copies of 12th marksheet and certificate Graduation and post-graduation marksheet and certificate (if applicable) One-year Data Entry Operator / Programming diploma certificate Local resident (sthai niwas) certificate issued by competent revenue authority Caste certificate for reserved categories issued by competent authority Non-creamy layer certificate for OBC candidates (issued within the last 3 years) Disability certificate issued by Medical Board (if applicable) Ex-serviceman identity card issued by District Soldier Welfare Office (if applicable) Employment exchange live registration card of Koriya district Experience certificate of Rojgar Sahayak issued by Chief Executive Officer, Janpad Panchayat (if applicable) NOC from employer if currently working in any institution/office

content_sections.heading: District Panchayat Koriya Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date and time (22 October 2026, 05:00 PM) or submitted directly by hand/ordinary post will not be accepted. Incomplete application forms or lack of required self-attested documents will lead to automatic rejection. No application fee or correction window is provided after submission. Selected candidates will be appointed on a probation period of 3 years, which may be extended by 2 years. Providing false information will result in cancellation of candidature and legal action. Active employment registration in Koriya district employment exchange is mandatory.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: District Panchayat Koriya, Baikunthpur (Chhattisgarh) is conducting the recruitment.

faq.question: Q2. What post is being recruited under this notification?
faq.answer: Recruitment is being conducted for the Gram Panchayat Sachiv post.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: A total of 10 vacancies are announced for the Gram Panchayat Sachiv post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 22 October 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Higher Secondary board examination along with a one-year diploma in Data Entry Operator or Programming from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q6. Are applicants required to be local residents?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants must be native residents of Koriya district and have active employment exchange registration in Koriya district.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 35 years as of the notification date, with upper age relaxations applicable for reserved categories and local residents as per government rules.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline via registered post or speed post to the District Panchayat Koriya office.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a merit list prepared using Higher Secondary marks, higher qualifications, a computer skill test (English and Hindi typing), and Rojgar Sahayak experience.
